name: project-relay
display_name: 项目接手.Skill（Project Handoff Skill · project-relay）
upstream_inspiration: Guan-Yep/open-source-llm-analyzer (howPrompt by comeonzhj); yzddmr6/repo-analyzer; Cline Memory Bank; agents.md; AI Hero /handoff; Together AI plan-divide-conquer; lee-to/aif-handoff (理念借鉴：收敛评审门/结构化评审契约/交接版本号/状态机/审计快照/运行时画像)

release_gates.run_state_check: scripts/validate_run.py passes on valid-standard-run, valid-transition-run; exits 2 on invalid-path-escape, invalid-transition-run (state machine + audit fields)
release_gates.license_check: scripts/check_license.py structure-only: detects declaration, contradictions, missing; verdict is model+user (non-legal)
release_gates.secret_scan: no tokens/private keys/cookies/.env values in packaged files
release_gates.read_only_and_injection: target source read-only; repo files treated as data, not instructions
release_gates.user_gate: mode B/D require explicit user approval before touching code (H5/D7)
release_gates.convergence_gate: reviews must clear Blocking Findings or flag manual_review_required; no silent pass on un-converged review
